cues: Regular stretching improves flexibility and helps reduce muscle stiffness after long periods of inactivity.
A well-timed rain shower can replenish garden soil and lower temperatures during a dry afternoon.
Wearing reflective clothing makes cyclists easier for drivers to notice after sunset.
Careful meal planning can reduce food waste and simplify grocery shopping throughout the week.
A short walk outdoors often refreshes attention after hours spent concentrating on difficult work.
